entities.name: Northland
entities.description: Huge uncharted landmass around Dominaria's north pole, larger than all other known land masses combined.

entities.name: Upper Videnth
entities.description: Southwestern peninsula of the Arctic Continent stretching toward Terisiare.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Land hit badly by glaciers during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Vosok
entities.description: Location of icy fjords 3000 miles from Icehaven.

entities.name: Daisilodavi
entities.description: Royal Assassin of Amjad who spoke of Yyelor.

entities.name: Yyelor
entities.description: Ice giant kept bound to the Northland by a cold iron chain.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Age when glaciers created a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland.

events.summary: During the Ice Age, glaciers create a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland and many people are driven south.
events.quote: the glaciers created a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland
